import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final int N = 20;
        final double eps = 1e-10;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        double[] a = new double[n];
        int zeroCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = sc.nextDouble();
            if (a[i] < eps) zeroCount++;
        }
        k = Math.min(n - zeroCount, k);
        int size = 1 << n;
        double[] p = new double[size];
        double[] res = new double[n];
        p[0] = 1.0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < size; ++mask) {
            double sumA = 0.0;
            boolean ok = true;
            int cnt = 0;
            int m = mask;
            while (m != 0) {
                int i = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(m);
                sumA += a[i];
                if (a[i] < eps) ok = false;
                ++cnt;
                m &= m - 1;
            }
            if (!ok) {
                p[mask] = 0.0;
                continue;
            }
            double sumP = 0.0;
            m = mask;
            while (m != 0) {
                int i = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(m);
                sumP += a[i] / (1.0 - sumA + a[i]) * p[mask ^ (1 << i)];
                m &= m - 1;
            }
            p[mask] = sumP;
            if (cnt == k) {
                m = mask;
                while (m != 0) {
                    int i = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(m);
                    res[i] += p[mask];
                    m &= m - 1;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            System.out.printf("%.10f%c", res[i], (i == n - 1 ? '\n' : ' '));
        }
    }
}
